summary: Tested new Sombra sections (Hechicería, Fortalecer la voluntad, Cómo sucumbir) and complete Occupation Editor. Fixed runtime error in OccupationEditor when editing existing occupations. All 16 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed OccupationEditor runtime error: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading map)' - caused by existing occupations not having senda_sombra.defectos array
Sombra API returns all new fields: hechiceria, fortalecer_voluntad, como_sucumbir
Sombra page displays HECHICERÍA section with purple color
Sombra page displays FORTALECER LA VOLUNTAD section with blue color
Sombra page displays CÓMO SUCUMBIR ANTE LA SOMBRA section with warning styling
Occupation Editor shows max 2 characteristics limit with counter (X/2)
Occupation Editor shows max 2 saving throws limit with counter (X/2)
Occupation Editor shows max 3 favored skills limit with counter (X/3)
Occupation Editor shows 4 defect inputs for Shadow Path (obligatory)
Occupation Editor shows profession paths/specializations section
Occupation Editor shows virtue/art levels section
Shadow path defects sync to sombra_rules via POST /api/data/sombra/sendas
test_credentials: No login required - Maestro admin user active by default
seed_data_creation: Used existing data from sombra_rules, occupations collections
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sombra page now displays 8 sections: PAVOR, AVARICIA, FECHORÍAS, HECHICERÍA (new), FORTALECER LA VOLUNTAD (new), CÓMO SUCUMBIR ANTE LA SOMBRA (new), ESTADOS, SENDAS. OccupationEditor fixed to handle existing occupations without senda_sombra.defectos array. Editor validates max 2 characteristics, max 2 saves, max 3 skills, and requires 4 shadow path defects.
